title: Paytm Q1 Results: Profit soars 79% YoY to Rs 220 crore; board decides not to go with bonus proposal
description: Paytm's net profit surged seventy-nine percent year-on-year to two hundred twenty crore rupees. The company's board decided against a bonus issue at this time. They will continue focusing on compounding growth and profitability for shareholders. This decision aims to enhance long-term shareholder value creation. The company emphasized its commitment to sustained financial performance.

title: Coca-Cola appoints JPMorgan, Citi for India bottler IPO, sources say
description: Coca-Cola has appointed JPMorgan and Citi for its planned 2027 initial public offering.  This significant move involves its majority-owned Indian bottling partner, Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings.  The beverage giant is preparing for this listing and exploring a partial stake sale.  This strategy aligns with other global firms tapping into India's growing equity markets.  The IPO aims to monetize investments, attracting valuations richer than domestic markets.

title: Shapoorji secures commitments for Rs 21,350 cr from investors including Mercury Finance, Deutsche Bank
description: Shapoorji Pallonji Group has secured investor commitments for its Rs 21,350 crore refinancing package, backed by its Tata Sons stake. The private credit deal, involving rupee and dollar debt, attracted strong interest from global distressed investors and domestic financial institutions.

title: NY Fed survey finds highest credit application rate in nearly five years
description: Americans’ demand for new credit hit a near five-year high in June, according to New York Fed data. While applications for credit cards and auto loans eased slightly since February, mortgage demand edged up. Meanwhile, more households reported difficulty covering unexpected $2,000 expenses, reflecting ongoing financial pressure.

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
description: Indian markets ended lower as escalating Iran-US tensions and rising crude prices weighed on sentiment. Analysts expect geopolitical risks, inflation and central bank actions to remain in focus, while resilient Q1 earnings support selective opportunities. Nifty faces resistance at 24,400 and support near 24,100.

title: Market Trading Guide: Lloyds Metals among 2 stock recommendations for Tuesday
description: Markets remain cautious amid rising geopolitical tensions, higher crude prices and inflation concerns. Despite global headwinds, encouraging Q1 earnings support sentiment. Analysts recommend buying Jana Small Finance Bank and Lloyds Metals after bullish technical breakouts backed by strong volumes and positive moving averages.

title: Iren shares jump 16% as $2.8 billion AI cloud deals lift revenue target
description: IREN shares surged after the company secured $2.8 billion in AI cloud contracts and raised its 2026 revenue target. Strong demand for GPU infrastructure, backed by major clients like Microsoft and Nvidia, highlights its shift from bitcoin mining to AI, with capacity expansion and prepayment-backed deals supporting growth visibility.

title: Sebi imposes Rs 1 crore penalty on CDSL over 2022 malware attack
description: Sebi has imposed a Rs 1 crore penalty on CDSL for cybersecurity failures that enabled a 2022 malware attack, disrupting depository operations and market settlements. The regulator cited inadequate protection of critical systems, weak access controls and poor security monitoring despite prescribed cybersecurity requirements.

title: Steptrade’s pre-IPO fund secures Rs 100 crore in first close
description: Steptrade Capital has raised over Rs 100 crore in the first close of its Rs 500 crore Chanakya Opportunities Fund II. The Category II AIF will invest in growth-stage pre-IPO companies across manufacturing, energy transition and emerging technology sectors, beginning deployments in August.

title: US stocks today: US stocks open higher as chips recover, megacap earnings loom
description: Wall Street opened higher as chip stocks rebounded from last week’s sharp decline, supporting gains across major indexes. Investors are now focused on upcoming earnings from leading technology companies driving the AI rally, with sentiment stabilising despite recent volatility and ongoing uncertainty around interest rates and global risks.
